description: FAIR COMPARISON - Single-Modal baseline with IDENTICAL settings to dual-modal production config. Same: (1) batch_size=4, (2) steps=829 (100% data), (3) VGG perceptual loss weight=5.0, (4) 50 epochs, (5) Same learning rates. ONLY DIFFERENCE: Image-only discriminator (NO text features, NO CTC loss). This proves whether dual-modal truly provides benefit.
_purpose: Apple-to-apple comparison: dual-modal vs single-modal with ALL other factors controlled
_only_difference: Discriminator: single-modal IMAGE-ONLY (no text features, no HTR recognizer, no CTC loss)
_key_ablation: CTC loss = 0.0 for single-modal (vs 5.0 for dual-modal) - this is THE critical difference
_hypothesis: Dual-modal discriminator (image + text features) provides better guidance → higher PSNR/CER
_null_hypothesis: Text features provide no benefit, single-modal achieves same results
_expected_single_modal: PSNR ~24-26 dB (should be lower without text guidance)
_minimum_gap_for_claim: Dual-modal must be ≥1.0 dB PSNR better to claim superiority
_baseline_quickwin_dual: PSNR 22.68 dB, CER 0.3137 (12% data, no VGG)
_production_dual_modal: PSNR 25-28 dB, CER <0.30 (target with 100% data + VGG)
_this_single_modal: PSNR 24-26 dB, CER ~0.31 (should be lower than dual-modal)
_gap_interpretation: If gap <0.5 dB → dual-modal not significant. If gap >1.5 dB → strong evidence
_comment_charset: ⚠️ NOT USED by single-modal discriminator, but required by launcher script
_comment_recognizer: ⚠️ NOT USED by single-modal (CTC=0), but required by launcher script
_discriminator_note: Image-only discriminator - NO text features, NO HTR recognizer needed
_disc_note: Config kept same as dual-modal, but NO text fusion happens in single_modal discriminator
_lstm_note: ⚠️ SINGLE-MODAL: LSTM not used (no text recognition)
_perceptual_note: VGG loss ACTIVE - same as dual-modal
_adv_note: Same total effective loss as dual-modal (which has adv=1.5 + ctc=5.0 = 6.5 total)
_ctc_note: ⚠️ CRITICAL: CTC loss DISABLED for single-modal (no text supervision)
_rec_feat_note: ⚠️ ABLATION: RecFeat loss DISABLED (no text features in discriminator)
_curriculum_note: Disabled for single-modal (no CTC to anneal)
_warmup_note: ⚠️ SINGLE-MODAL: No curriculum needed (no CTC to anneal)
_early_stopping_note: curriculum_aware=false because no CTC annealing in single-modal
_stopping_note: Same patience and criteria as dual-modal
_comment_gpu: GPU 1 for parallel training (dual-modal runs on GPU 0)
_statistical_test: Use paired t-test on validation set to confirm significance
_significance_level: p < 0.05 with effect size Cohen's d > 0.5
_per_epoch: ~15 minutes (829 steps, single-modal is slightly faster than dual-modal)
_criterion_1: PSNR ≥ 24 dB (should beat baseline 20.01 dB significantly)
_criterion_2: PSNR < dual-modal by ≥1.0 dB (validates dual-modal superiority)
_criterion_3: CER ≤ 0.32 (should be similar or slightly worse than dual-modal)
_ablation_study: This is Table X in ablation study section
_paper_claim: Dual-modal discriminator improves PSNR by X.X dB over single-modal baseline (p < 0.05)
_parallel_note: Can run simultaneously with dual-modal (uses same GPU 0 but time-shared)
_recommendation: Wait for dual-modal to finish first, then launch this for clean comparison
